plan.notes: Source: Temple University Undergraduate Bulletin (current), 'Information Science and Technology BS — Suggested Plan for New Students Starting in the 2026-2027 Academic Year'. 123 total credits, 8 semesters; semester sums match catalog-published term totals (16/15/15/15/16/16/15/15). The plan publishes credit ranges on elective slots (3-4, 2-1, 3-2, 2-0); each term is transcribed at the combination that sums exactly to the catalog's published term total, documented faithfully here: Year 3 Fall = IST elective 3 + elective 2; Year 3 Spring = IST elective 3 + elective 3; Year 4 Fall = IST elective 3 + GenEd 3 + elective 2; Year 4 Spring = IST elective 3 + elective 2. Prerequisite ordering verified: CIS 1051/1057/1951 before CIS 1068 before CIS 2168; MATH 1041 before MATH 2031; CIS 2168 before CIS 3309; CIS 3309 before CIS 3342; CIS 3342 before CIS 4296 before CIS 4396.
